theme_and_archetype.description: Authority, Clarity, Truth. A 'Zero-Touch' AI-native ERP for India Localization (GST, TDS). The design must feel like a precision instrument—objective, rigid, and functional. Purely data-driven with zero visual clutter. Color exists solely to guide action or indicate status.

rules: The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: Never use pure black/grey. Greys must be slightly tinted with blue (slate/gray in Tailwind) for a crisp, clinical feel.
95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action (Klein Blue for AI/CTAs, Red for mismatches).
High Contrast: Ensure text over any background passes WCAG AA.
No generic sans for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk for dramatic, structural headers.
All financial data (Amounts, GSTINs, Trx IDs) MUST use JetBrains Mono for tabular alignment.
Never center text by default. Use left-alignment for dense financial data.

grid_strategy.name: The 'Control Room' Grid
grid_strategy.description: Dense, high-data correlation grid. Strict hierarchy with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children.
Generous Spacing Philosophy for macro-sections: Use 2-3x more spacing (e.g., p-8) around main containers to prevent claustrophobia.

surfaces_and_borders.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), NO shadow. Hover state adds -translate-y-[1px] and shadow-sm.
surfaces_and_borders.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers or AI prompt overlays. bg-white/80, backdrop-blur-xl, 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/40), shadow-sm.
surfaces_and_borders.grid_borders: For dense ledgers and tables, expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse with border-r and border-b on cells.
surfaces_and_borders.tracing_beam: Apply to the main AI Prompt Interface box. A glowing gradient line that travels around the border to signal 'AI is listening/processing'.

buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900

inputs.style: Shadcn based. Square or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). 1px border. Focus state must use high contrast ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#002FA7]).

ai_prompt_interface.description: The hero interaction model of the app. A large, dominant text area at the bottom or center of the screen.
ai_prompt_interface.visuals: Uses the Tracing Beam border effect. Monospace typography for the prompt input. Prominent 'Post/Generate' CTA.

ocr_document_view.description: Side-by-side or overlay bento grid. Left side: High-res image with zoom. Right side: Extracted fields matching the attachment.
ocr_document_view.visuals: Data points highlighted with Warning Yellow if unverified, Success Green once verified.

tables_and_ledgers.style: Cardless, dense layout. Use JetBrains Mono for figures. Highlight unmatched bank reco items with pale red background (bg-red-50) and Signal Red text.

charts.style: Recharts. Monochrome bars/lines with International Klein Blue as the primary data color. Signal Red for negative cash flow.

images.description: White abstract architecture lines. Use as a subtle, low-opacity background for login screens or empty states.
Minimalist blue geometric shape. Use as the avatar/icon for the Conversational Reporting Bot.
Sample receipt for testing/showcasing the P2P Document Upload & OCR functionality.
Sample formal invoice document for showcasing Order-to-Cash and Accruals OCR parsing.

media.icons_rationale: Perfect for dense dashboards and developer/financial tools. Gives a crisp, technical look.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST have explicit hover states. Avoid relying on inherited opacity. Instead, shift background colors (e.g., hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900).
interactions_and_motion.animations: Minimalist. Use framer-motion for micro-interactions only (e.g., the AI Tracing Beam border, staggered fade-ins for ledger rows).
interactions_and_motion.accessibility: Disable/reduce animations if prefers-reduced-motion is true. Focus states must have a 2px high-contrast ring.

testing_and_attributes.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, links, form inputs, menus, and AI prompt areas. Convention: kebab-case, role-based. Example: data-testid='ai-prompt-input', data-testid='post-journal-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'Zero-Touch' UI philosophy. The AI Prompt is the primary input method. Avoid traditional CRUD forms where possible.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid for all financial dashboards to ensure maximum data density without clutter.
Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric values, tables, and transaction IDs.
Use Shadcn UI extensively but strip away the default 'Vercel' look by applying sharp borders (rounded-none or sm) and flat backgrounds.
Integrate the provided image URLs strictly for their designated categories. Never use placeholder services.
Install the following dependencies: @phosphor-icons/react, framer-motion, recharts.
Ensure the AI Conversational Reporting Bot highlights the 'ai_bot_avatar' as its visual identity.
